detours.why: The Mississippi lies between the East Bank halls and the West Bank arts buildings; the mapped crossing is the Washington Avenue Bridge, north of the straight line.

The old plant's coal yard (Coal Unloading Facility and Coal Storage Building) lies between Sanford and Wilkins and the Education Sciences Building, below the bluff; the mapped way goes round by the street to the east.
The blocks between 17th Avenue Hall and the Knoll (houses and the Nolte Center garage) have no mapped path through; walks go south and round by the Mall to Pillsbury Hall and Nolte Center.
Roy Wilkins Hall's mapped way out is along University Avenue; the blocks between it and the Knoll have no mapped path through, so walks go round by the streets to Nolte Center and 10 Church Street.

The health sciences buildings (Mayo, Phillips-Wangensteen, Diehl, the Variety Club centers) form one built-up block with few mapped ways through; walks from the halls go round by Washington Avenue to its far side.
